idea-plugin.name: Amper Tasks
idea-plugin.description:
Native Gradle-style Task Tool Window for Kotlin Amper

Amper Tasks brings the familiar, convenient sidebar experience to Kotlin Amper projects in IntelliJ IDEA.

Key Features:

  • Zero Configuration: Automatically detects project.yaml, module.yaml, or ./kotlin wrapper upon opening.
  • Double-Click to Run: Double-click any task or select and press Enter to execute.
  • Integrated Console: Tasks stream directly into IntelliJ's standard Run tool window with ANSI colors and stop (■) control.
  • Smart Multi-Module Support: Run project-wide tasks or target specific submodules (-m <module>) without typing.
  • Application Run Support: Auto-detects product: app/... modules to provide one-click run tasks.
  • Publishing Discovery: Automatically generates publish tasks for repositories marked with publish: true (mavenLocal, Repsy, etc.).
  • Project & Module Inspection: Quick access to show modules, show tasks, show dependencies, and show settings.
